title: DispatchEnvelope
description: The dispatch envelope is a notification, not the truth (design.md §7.1): it carries the job identity and the contract version, and nothing else. A fourth field would make it a second, stale copy of the job record.

type.description: The version discriminator; a different literal is a contract change and must be rejected, never ignored.

job_id.description: The job identity; everything else is resolved from the job record.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 instant; the time offset is mandatory, and the grammar and the calendar are `format: date-time`'s job. The instant domain is years 0001-9999: RFC 3339 delegates the calendar to ISO 8601, whose calendar has no year 0000, so a timestamp beginning 0000 is rejected, not interpreted. The `pattern` says exactly that and nothing else -- restating the full grammar here would be a fourth copy of it, and a copy that could not check the calendar would look like the definition of the field while accepting February 30th.
